description: This file contains the implementation of an Android Fragment named HomeFragment, which serves as the main home screen for an Android TV application. It displays a horizontal top navigation bar and multiple vertical content rails, each containing a horizontal list of focusable content cards. The fragment manages view binding, sets up RecyclerView adapters for navigation and content rows, and includes mock data for content.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment representing the home screen for a TV app, showcasing a top navigation and multiple content rails with focus navigation support.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: A data class representing individual content items with an id, title, and image URL.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: A data class representing a row of content with a title and a list of ContentItems.

classes.name: MockContentData
classes.description: A helper object generating mock content data for development and testing purposes.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout and initializes view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the top navigation and content rails after view creation.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Initializes the horizontal RecyclerView for navigation categories, including a special search icon item.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Creates mock data for content rows and configures the vertical RecyclerView for displaying these content sections.
